verdict.rationale: Ledgy supports OAuth 2.0 service accounts with client_credentials grant, credentials 'scoped per integration', short-lived tokens, and immediate revocation/rotation (ledgy-docs-1,4,18,27,28,29), which functions as a least-privilege machine credential mechanism suitable for an autonomous agent. However, there is no explicit framing for AI agents, no documented fine-grained permission/scope selection beyond per-integration binding, and the API surface itself is narrow (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions) rather than a rich scope model. Missing for 10: explicit agent-oriented provisioning flow, granular read/write scope selection, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
